text: Two hundred years ago, the devil-worshipper Samri was beheaded by Raja Harimaan Singh, his head locked in a strong-box in the Raja's haveli, and he swore that [every woman of the Raja's line would die in childbirth|who_suffers|heirs of old wrongs]. Now the college student Suman, whose mother died bearing her, travels to Bijapur with her boyfriend Sanjay. Behind a painting whose eyes shift, they [break open the wall|trigger|unsealing what was shut away] and find the box, and soon Samri is whole again and rising [to wipe out the dynasty|wants|revenge for a wrong].
